items.q: Is converting PDF to text free?
items.a: Yes, converting PDF to text is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Does this preserve the original formatting?
items.a: Layout is approximated using spacing, but a plain text file can't preserve fonts, colors, or images — only the text content itself.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
